Commentary of al-Baghawi (Ma'alim al-Tanzil) on surah 98, verse 6–8:

Then He mentioned what awaits the two groups, saying: ﴿Indeed, those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein eternally. They are the worst of creation.﴾ Nafi' and Ibn 'Amir read "al-bari'a" (البريئة) with a hamza in both instances, because it derives from their saying: "Allah created (bara'a) the creation." The others read it with a shadda and without a hamza, like "al-dhurriyya" (الذرية), whose hamza was dropped in usage.

﴿Indeed, those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of creation. Their reward with their Lord is Gardens of Eden beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears his Lord.﴾ And [he] refrained from sins.

It was said: Contentment (al-ridha) is divided into two kinds: contentment with Him (ridan bihi) and contentment with what comes from Him (ridan 'anhu). Contentment with Him is being pleased with Him as Lord and Manager; contentment with what comes from Him is being pleased with what He decrees and destines.

Al-Suddi, may Allah have mercy on him, said: If you are not pleased with Allah, how can you ask Him to be pleased with you?

Abd al-Wahid al-Malihi informed us, Ahmad ibn 'Abd Allah al-Nu'aymi informed us, Muhammad ibn Yusuf informed us, Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Ghundar narrated to us, Shu'ba narrated to us, who said: I heard Qatada narrate from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubayy: "Indeed Allah, the Exalted, commanded me to recite to you: 'Those who disbelieved...'" He said: "And he named me?" He said: "Yes." So he wept. [[Narrated by al-Bukhari in Tafsir, Tafsir of Surah al-Bayyina - 8/725.]]

Hammam narrated from Qatada: "He commanded me to recite the Qur'an to you." [[Narrated by al-Bukhari in the previous place, and in the Virtues of the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), chapter on the virtues of Ubayy ibn Ka'b, and Muslim in Prayer of Travelers, chapter on the recommendation of reciting the Qur'an to people of virtue and skill in it, no. (799): 1/550.]]

Abd al-Wahid al-Malihi informed us, Ahmad ibn 'Abd Allah al-Nu'aymi informed us, Muhammad ibn Yusuf informed us, Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Ghundar narrated to us, Shu'ba narrated to us, who said: I heard Qatada narrate from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubayy: "Indeed Allah, the Exalted, commanded me to recite to you: 'Those who disbelieved...'" He said: "And he named me?" He said: "Yes." So he wept. [[Narrated by al-Bukhari in Tafsir, Tafsir of Surah al-Bayyina - 8/725.]]

Hammam narrated from Qatada: "He commanded me to recite the Qur'an to you." [[Narrated by al-Bukhari in the previous place, and in the Virtues of the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), chapter on the virtues of Ubayy ibn Ka'b, and Muslim in Prayer of Travelers, chapter on the recommendation of reciting the Qur'an to people of virtue and skill in it, no. (799): 1/550.]]
